if(CLINGCON_BUILD_TESTS)
    if(NOT TARGET Catch2::Catch2WithMain)
        if(CLINGCON_USE_LOCAL_CATCH)
            set(CATCH_BUILD_STATIC_LIBRARY ON CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE)
            add_subdirectory(catch)
        else()
            find_package(Catch2 3.1 REQUIRED)
        endif()
        include(CTest)
        include(Catch)
    endif()
    if(CLINGCON_BUILD_PYTHON)
        list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/pytest-cmake/cmake")
        find_package(Pytest 8.0.0 REQUIRED)
    endif()
endif()

if(CLINGCON_BUILD_PYTHON AND NOT DEFINED SKBUILD)
    add_subdirectory(pybind11)
endif()

add_library(libwide-integer INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(libwide-integer INTERFACE
    "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wide-integer>")
